label: consistent

said.text: Under the War Powers Act, we will bring a resolution to the floor this week led by Senator Tammy Duckworth, a combat veteran who understands the true cost of war in a way Donald Trump never will. … And we will not stop there. If Republicans block it, we will vote again.

did.text: Voted Yes on S.J.Res. 185, a joint resolution to direct the removal of U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities within or against Iran that have not been authorized by Congress. Rejected 47–50.

whyNote: In April floor remarks, Sen. Schumer said Senate Democrats would keep bringing Iran war powers resolutions to the floor if earlier ones were blocked. In June he voted yes on S.J.Res. 185, one of the subsequent Iran war powers resolutions. The April remarks concerned an earlier resolution in the same series, not S.J.Res. 185 specifically.
